title: Countess of Hertfor Emily Seymour
dates: (1816-1902)
---

supporter of the Mothers’ Union

She married (1839) the 5th Marquess of Hertford (1812-1884), who succeeded his notoriously dissolute cousin in 1870.

As a recent widow, she was an early and enthusiastic supporter of the Mothers’ Union.
